title: Marrakesh Treaty Implementation Act
official_summary:
Marrakesh Treaty Implementation Act

(Sec. 2) This bill amends federal copyright law to implement the Marrakesh Treaty to Facilitate Access to Published Works for Persons Who Are Blind, Visually Impaired, or Otherwise Print Disabled (Marrakesh Treaty).

Specifically, it modifies the limitations and exceptions to federal copyright infringement that allow published works to be reproduced and distributed in accessible formats for individuals with print disabilities. The bill:

  • makes such limitations and exceptions applicable only to activities in the United States,
  • broadens the scope of published works that may be reproduced and distributed in accessible formats, and
  • modifies certain terms and definitions to conform with the Marrakesh Treaty.

Additionally, the bill adds a new section to allow published works in accessible formats to be exported and imported for individuals with print disabilities.

summary.headline: This law changes US copyright rules so that books and other published works can be made and shared in accessible formats, such as braille or audio, for people with print disabilities.
summary.what_it_does: It amends federal copyright law to carry out the Marrakesh Treaty, an international agreement on access to published works for people who are blind, visually impaired, or otherwise print disabled. The existing copyright exceptions that let accessible copies be made and distributed are limited to activities inside the United States. The law also widens the types of published works that can be copied into accessible formats and updates some key terms to match the treaty. A new section allows accessible-format works to be exported to and imported from other treaty countries for these individuals.

who_it_affects.group: People who are blind, visually impaired, or otherwise print disabled
who_it_affects.how: They can get more published works in accessible formats, and these works can be moved across borders for their use.

who_it_affects.group: Libraries and nonprofit organizations that serve people with print disabilities
who_it_affects.how: They may make and distribute accessible copies of a wider range of published works under the copyright exceptions.
The copyright exceptions for accessible-format copies now apply to a broader set of works, and the exceptions cover only activities within the United States.

who_it_affects.group: Organizations that import or export accessible-format works
who_it_affects.how: They may send and receive accessible-format works across borders for qualifying individuals under the new section.
